name: SDG
recent: SD Guthrie 近期宣布一项非关联方交易：与 YTL Power 旗下公司等成立合资公司，以约 RM933.57 million 出售位于 Bukit Kerayong 的永久地契土地，并投资最高 RM101.12 million 取得合资公司 30% 股权。同期，Amanah Saham Bumiputera 增持至 35%。公司公布截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度业绩，营收环比增长 9.1%，但净利环比下降 21.7%。
notable: 拟以约 RM933.57 million 现金出售 Bukit Kerayong 永久地契土地予合资公司 BKID。
与 YTL Power 旗下公司等成立合资公司，并投资最高 RM101.12 million 取得 30% 股权。
Amanah Saham Bumiputera 增持公司股份至 35%。
risks: 季度净利环比下降 21.7%，净利率由 20.0% 降至 14.3%。
新闻提及印尼土地纠纷、烟霾及 El Niño 等运营风险。
earnings: 截至 2026 年 9 月 30 日季度，营收为 RM5,393 million，环比增长 9.1%，同比增长 4.3%；净利为 RM773 million，环比下降 21.7%，同比增长 44.2%；净利率为 14.3%，低于上一季度的 20.0%。

recent_en: SD Guthrie recently announced a non-related party transaction to form a joint venture and dispose of freehold land in Bukit Kerayong for approximately RM933.57 million, while investing up to RM101.12 million for a 30% stake in the JV. Meanwhile, Amanah Saham Bumiputera raised its stake to 35%. The company reported quarterly results for the period ended 30 September 2026, with revenue up 9.1% QoQ but net income down 21.7% QoQ.
notable_en: Proposed disposal of freehold land in Bukit Kerayong to JV company BKID for approximately RM933.57 million cash.
Formed a joint venture with YTL Power's subsidiary and others, investing up to RM101.12 million for a 30% stake.
Amanah Saham Bumiputera increased its stake in the company to 35%.
risks_en: Quarterly net income fell 21.7% QoQ, with net margin declining from 20.0% to 14.3%.
News highlighted operational risks in Indonesia including land disputes, haze and El Niño.
earnings_en: For the quarter ended 30 September 2026, revenue was RM5,393 million, up 9.1% QoQ and 4.3% YoY; net income was RM773 million, down 21.7% QoQ but up 44.2% YoY; net margin was 14.3%, lower than 20.0% in the previous quarter.
